name: Plugin Session Delete
description: 跨会话智能用户记忆库：持久化记录用户的编码偏好、技术栈规范与历史决策，无需在每个新对话中重复设定 Context。
descriptionEn: Delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the UI: header danger button + sidebar session-row menu item (no conversation jump), risk-consent dialog with session name/id, stops running agents first, in-place list refresh without page reload. Works in web and the desktop client.
author: MingLin
